question: Which Indian among the following has his name in Time Magazine's list of '100 most influential people of 2021'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Narendra Modi has been recognized in Time Magazine's list of '100 most influential people' multiple times, including in 2021, due to his significant impact on Indian and global politics.
 
• As the Prime Minister of India since 2014, Modi has implemented several major reforms and initiatives aimed at enhancing India's economic and social landscapes.
 
• His notable initiatives include the Digital India campaign, Make in India, Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, and Atmanirbhar Bharat, which have been influential in shaping India's development trajectory.
 
• Modi's leadership during the COVID-19 pandemic, including the rollout of the vaccination program and economic relief measures, has also been a key factor in his inclusion in the list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential People**

 
 
• Time Magazine's list of the 100 most influential people is an annual ranking that recognizes the contributions and impact of various individuals across different fields.
 
• The list includes leaders, innovators, artists, and icons who have made significant strides in their respective domains and have had a profound influence on the world stage.
 
• Being featured in this list is considered a prestigious honor, highlighting the individual's influence and achievements on a global scale.
 
• The list is divided into various categories, including leaders, pioneers, titans, artists, and icons, reflecting the diverse areas of influence and impact.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi's Major Initiatives**
 
 
• **Digital India:** A campaign launched to ensure the government's services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and increasing Internet connectivity.
 
• **Make in India:** An initiative aimed at transforming India into a global manufacturing hub by encouraging both multinational and domestic companies to manufacture their products in India.
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:** A national campaign initiated to clean the streets, roads, and infrastructure of India's cities and rural areas, promoting hygiene and sanitation.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** A vision of making India a self-reliant nation by promoting local production and reducing dependence on imports, especially in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
